in_marathi.name: Samruddhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samruddhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Samruddhi means 'Prosperity, Growth'. It is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the word 'Samruddha' which means 'Expansive, Wide-ranging'. The name Samruddhi signifies abundance and prosperity in all areas of life. It is a name that inspires growth, success, and abundance.
